days.title: Before the Famous Mouse
days.hook: Have you ever made a tiny cartoon flipbook and wondered if anyone else would watch it?
days.readingPassage: Have you ever made a tiny cartoon flipbook and wondered if anyone else would watch it? On **October 16, 1923**, **Walt Disney** signed a contract to distribute a cartoon series called the **Alice Comedies**. That contract became the official start of the Disney company. Walt and his brother **Roy** worked together as equal partners, first calling their business the **Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio**. Their studio was small, but their idea was huge: mix a real girl with an animated cartoon world. Walt made the Alice Comedies for **4 years**, creating **56 short films**. Then, in **1927**, he switched to an all-cartoon series starring **Oswald the Lucky Rabbit**. Within one year, Walt made **26 Oswald cartoons**. The famous mouse that many children know today came later, so Disney’s story did not begin with Mickey. It began with a contract, two brothers, and a lot of drawings. You can imagine papers, pencils, and cartoon characters taking over a room faster than toys after a busy playdate! That small studio grew into a company known around the world for animation and storytelling.
trivia: The Alice Comedies mixed live-action scenes with animation.
Disney’s first named recurring animated character was Julius, a cat in the Alice cartoons.

level3.prompt: Walt made the Alice Comedies for 4 years. If each year has 12 months, how many months did that project last?
